key.name: position
key.summary: Panel box the indicator is placed in

key.name: index
key.summary: Position of the indicator inside its panel box

key.name: label-width
key.summary: Maximum width of the track label in pixels

key.name: scroll-label
key.summary: Scroll the label when it does not fit (otherwise ellipsize)

key.name: label-format
key.description: Tokens: {title}, {artist}, {album}, {player}. Separators next to empty tokens are dropped.

key.name: show-art-icon
key.summary: Show album art (or the player icon) in the panel

key.name: show-controls
key.summary: Show previous/play/next buttons in the panel

key.name: hide-shell-media-notification
key.summary: Hide GNOME Shell's own media controls in the notification list

key.name: blacklist
key.description: Matched case-insensitively against the bus-name suffix, Identity and DesktopEntry.

key.name: pinned-player
key.description: Always prefer this player while it is running. Matched like blacklist entries. Empty means no pin.
